_comment: Known, deliberate differences between the raw Diagbox database and the
generated profile. Everything listed here is accepted by
tools/parity/make_golden.py and recorded in the fixture, so a deviation is
visible and greppable instead of silently tolerated. Anything NOT listed
Adding an entry is a decision about what the apps display; removing one
means make_profile.py was changed to match the database, which requires
regenerating the profile and re-releasing all three versions.

why: In the database these three are data_type BINARY with neither a factor
nor a state list, which is how Diagbox marks a raw byte it prints as
hex - they look like bit fields (0x14, 0x08). make_profile.py only
flags identification fields as hex, so these decode as plain numbers
in all three versions instead. The value is identical either way,
only the formatting differs; changing it would alter what index.html
and the Android app already show.
